neighbours.label: the token after a pronoun when it is not the expected verb: a split verb start after ' I' (I a|woke, I in|haled, I F|elt) or a stray word (it that), as opposed to the ordinary verb after ' I'
fire: I awakened to the sound of rain on the roof.
I exhaled slowly and put the cup down.

I enrolled in the class during the fall.
The main problem, in short, it that it costs too much.
I overslept and missed the first train.
I unpacked my bag and I that it was empty.
quiet: I heard the sound of rain on the roof.
I sat slowly and put the cup down.
I saw every minute of the show.
I admire this and I know that they tried so hard.
I took the class during the fall.
The main problem, in short, is that it costs too much.

notes: 'She awoke' reached 0.15, so the pronoun I or the split may matter. Other card peaks ('-temp', ' Ch', ' Chart') are not covered.
